items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: I don't know that Red Allen being one band and Kid Red back there and the other one. That's a good band. Rough band, man.

ctx.x: Is there anything about the different bands, the brass bands that you've played in, that you could tell us? Any organized band or just different make-up bands?
No, no, I played in the most organized band that I played in, the brass band, was with old man Allen, Red Allen's daddy. Allen's brass band.
Did you have any other name for his band?

items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: One of the things I call him, Uncle Alan, see we come up with the, his mom and all together

ctx.x: He is a great guy. Just to show you, I mean, if he would have got disgusted and gave up that night, wouldn't he listen to that? He probably would have been walking around.
One of the things I call him, Uncle Alan, see we come up with the, his mom and all together, he used to try to play clarinet too when he was small. But he could dance.
Oh yeah, he was a tap dancer. He was a Bill Robinson.
